description: This file defines a report class for summarizing opportunities by sales stage in an ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and chart generation.

classes.name: OpportunitySummaryBySalesStage
classes.description: Class responsible for generating opportunity summary reports grouped by sales stage, with methods for data fetching, processing, and chart creation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes and runs the OpportunitySummaryBySalesStage report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report with filters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to generate report columns, data, and chart.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on filters.

methods.name: set_sales_stage_columns
methods.description: Adds columns for each sales stage based on data type (Number or Amount).

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes opportunity data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data_query
methods.description: Executes database queries to retrieve opportunity data, with currency conversion if needed.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Formats raw data into report rows.

methods.name: get_formatted_data
methods.description: Prepares data for report display, handling opportunity owner assignments.

methods.name: set_formatted_data_based_on_sales_stage
methods.description: Aggregates data counts or amounts per sales stage.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds query filters based on report filters.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data from the query results.

methods.name: currency_conversion
methods.description: Converts currency amounts using cached exchange rates.

methods.name: get_default_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the default currency for the company.

methods.name: convert_to_base_currency
methods.description: Converts all opportunity amounts to the company's base currency.
